_comment: Temporary npm audit exceptions. Each entry needs id (GHSA or CVE), reason, issue (GitHub issue URL), exposure (runtime|build), and review_by (YYYY-MM-DD). Expired, unused, or build-classified runtime findings fail the security gate. Prefer a targeted lockfile/override fix over an exception.

exceptions.reason: deepmerge <=4.3.1 prototype poisoning in mergeObject(); no patched release exists (latest is 4.3.1). Reached only via the dev-only shadcn CLI; not in npm audit --omit=dev nor in frontend/dist.

minimatch <11.0.1 DoS via globparts amplification; only the 11.x major is patched and the 3.x/5.x/10.x consumers (eslint, @redocly/openapi-core, filelist, typescript-eslint, ts-morph) are not API-compatible with it. Dev/build toolchain only; not in npm audit --omit=dev nor in frontend/dist.
